hero.promise: Tomodachi teaches Japanese with Arabic-first bilingual lessons, duels, and co-op with friends.
hero.success_body: We'll let you know when Tomodachi launches.

arabic_first.title: Arabic From the Start
arabic_first.body: Lessons are authored in Arabic, with grammar notes and memory hooks built for Arabic linguistic instincts.

multiplayer.title: Duels and Co-Op
multiplayer.body: Live duels and co-op sessions bring friends into the same drill, keeping practice social without slowing it down.

calm_pace.title: Pace Without Guilt
calm_pace.body: Miss a day? Your streak survives. Tomodachi keeps pace with real schedules, not guilt loops.

screenshots.section_subtitle: A peek at the dashboard, gameplay, and leaderboard.

consent.title: Cookie preferences
consent.body: Tomodachi uses essential cookies to run the app. Optional analytics and error-context cookies help us improve — your call.
consent.modal_subtitle: Choose which categories to allow. You can change this any time from Settings.
consent.essential_desc: Required for sign-in and core app features. Cannot be disabled.
consent.analytics_desc: Helps us understand which features get used. Aggregated, never sold.
consent.error_desc: Captures error reports with your account info attached, so we can debug faster. Errors are still captured without it, just anonymously.

launch.question: When is Tomodachi launching?
launch.answer: Tomodachi does not have a fixed launch date yet. We are holding release until the learning experience and Arabic quality meet the bar, and waitlist members will be invited to the closed beta first.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: The first beta wave will be free. Later, Tomodachi will add a Pro tier for power-user features, while the free experience stays substantial.

mobile.question: Will there be a mobile app?
mobile.answer: Tomodachi already works on mobile in the browser, and it supports home-screen installation as a PWA. Native iOS and Android apps are on the roadmap, but they are not the first release target.

arabic_first.question: Why Arabic-first?
arabic_first.answer: Most Japanese-learning apps start in English and treat Arabic as a later layer. Tomodachi authors Arabic pedagogy natively — explanations written by people thinking in Arabic — so grammar, memory cues, and examples feel closer to the learner.

levels.question: What Japanese levels will be covered?
levels.answer: Tomodachi starts with JLPT N5: kana, about 800 vocabulary items, about 100 kanji, and N5 grammar. N4 follows after that, while N3 and beyond remain roadmap items, not promises.

data.question: How is my data handled?
data.answer: We store the minimum needed to run the product: email, display name, and game results. We do not sell data, the full privacy policy lives at /privacy, and deleting your account from Settings removes everything.

pro_cost.question: What will Pro cost?
pro_cost.answer: Final pricing is not set. We are planning regional pricing around $2/month equivalent for Egypt, roughly 70 EGP, and around $4/month equivalent for Gulf countries, with affordability as the main goal.

dialect.question: I don't speak Egyptian Arabic — will it work for me?
dialect.answer: Yes. All content ships in Modern Standard Arabic, so Arabic readers can use it regardless of dialect, with no Egyptian colloquialisms or region-specific wording that excludes Gulf, Levantine, or Maghrebi users.
